answer: Every action emits a pulse recorded in the agent's thread, and new identities must accrue sustained, costly participation before gaining weight. Sybil resistance can be grounded in a persistent reputation slot atlas that binds each agent to a verifiable on-chain history rather than a disposable key. Attackers face real sunk costs: each fake identity needs separate stake, time, and reputation to matter, making mass fabrication economically irrational and easily detected. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
